raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Changes

Split the DFlash capture policy from the Muse Spark RMSNorm change in #46622. Add process-wide opt-in `SGLANG_DFLASH_COMPACT_CUDA_GRAPHS=1` to retain geometrically spaced automatic target-verification buckets after alignment/capacity filtering. Preserve the smallest/largest eligible buckets and the published configuration.

**Changed defaults: none.** The new flag defaults to **false**, so every DFlash model keeps main's dense capture policy. Explicit batch-size lists, draft workers, non-DFlash models, no-padding mode, non-full graph backends, two-batch overlap, non-CUDA paths and missing configuration provenance retain the original policy even when enabled.

Opt-in example: `SGLANG_DFLASH_COMPACT_CUDA_GRAPHS=1 python -m sglang.launch_server ...`. With max batch size 64 this retains `[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]`; intermediate batches can do more padded verification work.

## Paired comparison on current main

**Draft / not ready to merge.** Measurements are complete, but enabled-path throughput fell at all three requested intermediate concurrencies, and AIME lost one correct answer in seed 43. This is a graph-count/startup tradeoff, not a serving-speed improvement; changing the default is not supported.

Clean control `c43abd6d9e38a14e81bdb77c648a06353e1c10ee`; isolated candidate `1db8e022ef04efd21bef71b7a526b4eb99208657`, with no RMSNorm patch on either side. Measured 2026-10-27 UTC on the same 8 × B200, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Transformers 5.19.0. Main advanced through `dea05ca16eb53e677e7568f594e01e3ff8dd3e3f`; intervening changes were inspected (disabled async probes, DSV4-only allocation/capture, diffusion, multimodal enum move, and Mooncake CI registration). Relevant Muse layers and graph-selection sources are unchanged. These results remain labeled with their actual c43 control.

TP8/EP8, NVFP4 target weights, FP8 KV, DFlash with 8 draft tokens, max-running/max-decode-graph batch size 64; automatic fused-op dispatch. Two seeds, in order main42 → PR42 → PR43 → main43, separate services, shared compiled-kernel cache after both smoke runs, KV flushed before workloads. Full config, pinned model/data identities and commands are in the evidence (`compaction-e2e-20261027.json`).

### Streaming performance

Each cell uses 256 fixed 8192-input/1024-output requests per seed. Throughput is the arithmetic mean of seed rates; latency/TTFT/TPOT mean and p95 pool the 512 request observations, without averaging percentiles.

| Concurrency | req/s main → PR | Latency mean / p95 (s), main → PR | TTFT mean / p95 (ms), main → PR | TPOT mean / p95 (ms), main → PR | Failed / attempted |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | 2.8991 → 2.8016 (-3.36%) | 3.380 / 3.954 → 3.508 / 4.107 | 195.183 / 481.517 → 199.040 / 448.519 | 3.113 / 3.566 → 3.234 / 3.595 | 0/512 → 0/512 |
| 24 | 4.5235 → 4.4140 (-2.42%) | 5.116 / 6.653 → 5.248 / 6.716 | 521.028 / 1467.929 → 513.917 / 1474.747 | 4.492 / 5.827 → 4.627 / 5.741 | 0/512 → 0/512 |
| 48 | 5.6299 → 5.5047 (-2.23%) | 7.891 / 11.295 → 8.057 / 11.412 | 1262.160 / 3152.158 → 1312.014 / 3144.787 | 6.479 / 10.047 → 6.593 / 10.097 | 0/512 → 0/512 |

### Non-streaming quality

Full original GSM8K and AIME at c24, unchanged prompts, strict final-answer parser and output limits 8192/32768. WER/SIM are inapplicable to these text mathematics tasks.

| Dataset | Main correct, seeds 42 / 43 | PR correct, seeds 42 / 43 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GSM8K (1319) | 1266 / 1261 | 1266 / 1264 |
| AIME (30) | 28 / 29 | 28 / 28 |

All 2698 quality requests per arm completed without transport errors. AIME length-cap finishes were main 1/1, PR 2/1. Preserve the observed seed-43 accuracy regression; no scorer/cap changes or selection of a favorable repeat.

## Costs

| Metric | Main | PR | Delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Startup to ready, mean (s) | 204.26 | 180.23 | -24.03 |
| Peak device use, mean of per-arm max (GiB) | 127.893 | 127.854 | -0.039 |
| Target verification graphs per worker | 27 | 7 | -20 |
| Reported target verification graph memory, rank 0 mean (GB) | 0.458 | 0.100 | -0.358 |

All eight workers' actual captures were checked. Target prefill graphs (74) and draft verification graphs (27) are unchanged. Graph allocator accounting is not total VRAM: observed peak device use is nearly unchanged. Startup was measured after smoke/cache preparation; per-seed details and memory samples are retained.

## Tests / CI

- All **6 full-package regression tests passed** on the measured candidate: default-off behavior, explicit/excluded modes, intermediate padding, alignment/capacity order, immutable configuration, non-power-of-two endpoints and capacity coverage. Registered in `base-a-test-cpu`.
- Both full-server B200 smoke runs passed. Complete serving ABBA audit passed: actual source hashes/capture buckets, equal per-seed input ordering and configuration, exact token counts, complete dataset coverage, zero transport errors.
- Enabled-path end-to-end validation covers Muse Spark only. Default-off and excluded-path unit tests cover preservation of shared behavior; no cross-model enabled-path speedup or quality claim.
- Pinned Ruff/isort and `git diff --check` passed. No doc/ or docs/ changes.
- Current-head [lint](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40447946276) passed. [PR Test Base](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40447946321) stopped at the [draft gate](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40447946321/job/122003737372); test jobs, including `base-a-test-cpu`, were skipped and did not execute. The AIME regression is why this remains draft; local tests do not replace upstream CI or reviewer approval.

Developed with [OpenRSI-Index](https://github.com/OpenRSI-Foundation/OpenRSI-Index) / [RSI-Harness](https://github.com/OpenRSI-Foundation/OpenRSI-Index/tree/main/RSI-Harness); [one evidence archive](https://gist.github.com/Zhuofeng-Li/5a9672c6c53d69c42b6948acdd95f1a1) contains original authorship, raw measurements, source identities, commands and historical context.

nodes.body:
Thanks for splitting this out, keeping the default dense and measuring c10, c24 and c48. That addresses the scope and measurement requests from my review on #46622.

On AIME the paired results are small either way. Across problem and seed pairs, 2 are right only on main and 1 only on the PR (GSM8K 24 and 27), so they neither show a regression nor rule one out. Main solved `source_index` 21 in both c24 seeds, while the PR missed it twice (once at the length cap, once with a wrong answer), and the PR solved problem 29 in seed 42 where main did not. Since the quality requests run at temperature 0, extra seeds mainly vary the batching, so paired c24 repeats that log the verification bucket each request used would be more informative. A run at batch 1 could serve as a control, though both policies keep bucket 1, so it would not exercise the changed padding.

The evidence also shows `max_total_num_tokens` at 1764480 on main and 1791616 with the flag in both seeds, about 1.5 percent more KV capacity. That fits KV sizing after graph capture absorbing the freed graph memory, would explain the flat peak, and could go in the Costs table.

My main question is when someone should turn this on. Throughput is lower at all three concurrencies, while the gains are about 24 s of startup and about 1.5 percent more KV tokens. Which workloads are meant to benefit? One measurement where faster startup or the extra KV capacity matters would help maintainers judge whether the flag is worth carrying.

 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (

@@ -31,6 +33,7 @@

+def _compact_dflash_capture_sizes(
+    model_runner: ModelRunner, capture_bs: List[int], captured_req_width: int
+) -> List[int]:
+    """Opt in to fewer target-verification graphs with geometric buckets.
+
+    Full verification graphs include multiple token rows per request. Keep the
+    smallest and largest aligned sizes, but trade extra padding at intermediate
+    sizes for fewer resident graph executables. Explicit size lists and modes
+    that require exact sizes retain the original capture policy.
+    """
+    if not envs.SGLANG_DFLASH_COMPACT_CUDA_GRAPHS.get():
+        return capture_bs
+    locked = getattr(
+        getattr(model_runner, "server_args", None),
+        "_cuda_graph_config_locked",
+        None,
+    )
+    # Missing provenance must not turn an explicit list into an automatic one.
+    if locked is None or (Phase.DECODE, "bs") in locked:
+        return capture_bs
+    execution = get_exec()
+    if (
+        not is_cuda()
+        or execution.graph.disable_cuda_graph_padding
+        or execution.graph.cuda_graph_config.decode.backend != Backend.FULL
+        or execution.overlap.enable_two_batch_overlap
+        or captured_req_width <= 1
+        or model_runner.is_draft_worker
+        or not model_runner.spec_algorithm.is_dflash()
+    ):
+        return capture_bs
+
+    compact = [capture_bs[0]]
+    for size in capture_bs[1:-1]:
+        if size >= 2 * compact[-1]:
+            compact.append(size)
+    if compact[-1] != capture_bs[-1]:
+        compact.append(capture_bs[-1])
+    if len(compact) < len(capture_bs):
+        logger.info(
+            "DFLASH target CUDA graphs: retaining %d of %d automatic capture sizes: %s",
+            len(compact),
+            len(capture_bs),
+            compact,
+        )
+    return compact
+

     assert len(capture_bs) > 0 and capture_bs[0] > 0, f"{capture_bs=}"

@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+"""Automatic DFlash target graph buckets preserve capacity and explicit policy."""
+
+import bisect
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import (
+    Backend,
+    CudaGraphConfig,
+    Phase,
+    PhaseConfig,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import base_cuda_graph_runner as mod
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDFlashCaptureSizes(CustomTestCase):
+    sizes = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16]
+
+    def select(
+        self,
+        *,
+        sizes=None,
+        capacity=16,
+        alignment=1,
+        width=8,
+        explicit=False,
+        no_padding=False,
+        draft=False,
+        dflash=True,
+        backend=Backend.FULL,
+        overlap=False,
+        provenance=True,
+        cuda=True,
+        compact=True,
+    ):
+        sizes = list(self.sizes if sizes is None else sizes)
+        original = list(sizes)
+        args = NS()
+        if provenance:
+            args._cuda_graph_config_locked = (
+                {(Phase.DECODE, "bs")} if explicit else {(Phase.DECODE, "max_bs")}
+            )
+        runner = NS(
+            server_args=args,
+            req_to_token_pool=NS(size=capacity),
+            is_draft_worker=draft,
+            spec_algorithm=NS(is_dflash=lambda: dflash),
+        )
+        execution = NS(
+            graph=NS(
+                cuda_graph_config=CudaGraphConfig(
+                    decode=PhaseConfig(backend=backend, max_bs=max(sizes), bs=sizes)
+                ),
+                disable_cuda_graph_padding=no_padding,
+                torch_compile_max_bs=8,
+            ),
+            overlap=NS(enable_two_batch_overlap=overlap),
+        )
+        with (
+            mod.envs.SGLANG_DFLASH_COMPACT_CUDA_GRAPHS.override(compact),
+            patch.object(mod, "get_exec", return_value=execution),
+            patch.object(
+                mod, "get_flags", return_value=NS(capture=NS(enable_torch_compile=True))
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                mod, "get_cuda_graph_batch_size_alignment", return_value=alignment
+            ),
+            patch.object(mod.DllmConfig, "from_server_args", return_value=None),
+            patch.object(mod, "is_cuda", return_value=cuda),
+        ):
+            result = mod.get_batch_sizes_to_capture(runner, width)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            sizes, original, "Published configuration must remain immutable"
+        )
+        return result
+
+    def test_default_preserves_intermediate_buckets(self):
+        self.assertFalse(mod.envs.SGLANG_DFLASH_COMPACT_CUDA_GRAPHS.default)
+        for capacity in (16, 64, 256):
+            sizes = list(range(1, capacity + 1))
+            dense, _ = self.select(sizes=sizes, capacity=capacity, compact=False)
+            self.assertEqual(dense, sizes)
+            for batch in (10, 24, 48, 129, 136):
+                if batch <= capacity:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        mod.BaseCudaGraphRunner._pad_to_bucket(batch, dense), batch
+                    )
+
+    def test_automatic_target_preserves_endpoints_and_compile_subset(self):
+        captures, compiled = self.select()
+        self.assertEqual(captures, [1, 2, 4, 8, 16])
+        self.assertEqual(compiled, [1, 2, 4, 8])
+        for raw in range(1, 17):
+            padded = mod.BaseCudaGraphRunner._pad_to_bucket(raw, captures)
+            self.assertGreaterEqual(padded, raw)
+            self.assertLessEqual(padded, 16)
+
+    def test_explicit_sizes_and_other_modes_are_preserved(self):
+        cases = [
+            {"compact": False},
+            {"explicit": True},
+            {"no_padding": True},
+            {"draft": True},
+            {"dflash": False},
+            {"backend": Backend.BREAKABLE},
+            {"overlap": True},
+            {"width": 1},
+            {"provenance": False},
+            {"cuda": False},
+        ]
+        for case in cases:
+            with self.subTest(case=case):
+                captures, compiled = self.select(**case)
+                self.assertEqual(captures, self.sizes)
+                self.assertEqual(compiled, list(range(1, 9)))
+
+    def test_alignment_and_request_pool_limit_are_applied_first(self):
+        captures, compiled = self.select(capacity=14, alignment=4, width=2)
+        # Current main rounds the request-pool limit up to the TP alignment.
+        self.assertEqual(captures, [2, 4, 8, 16])
+        self.assertEqual(compiled, [2, 4, 8])
+        self.assertTrue(all(size * 2 % 4 == 0 for size in captures))
+
+    def test_non_power_of_two_capacity_and_single_bucket(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(capacity=13)[0], [1, 2, 4, 8, 13])
+        self.assertEqual(self.select(sizes=[8], capacity=8)[0], [8])
+
+    def test_capacity_coverage_across_aligned_configurations(self):
+        for capacity in (8, 15, 16, 31, 64, 127, 192):
+            for alignment in (1, 2, 4, 8):
+                for width in (2, 4, 8):
+                    source = list(range(1, capacity + 1))
+                    baseline = [
+                        size for size in source if size * width % alignment == 0
+                    ]
+                    captures, compiled = self.select(
+                        sizes=source,
+                        capacity=capacity,
+                        alignment=alignment,
+                        width=width,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(captures[0], baseline[0])
+                    self.assertEqual(captures[-1], baseline[-1])
+                    self.assertEqual(captures, sorted(set(captures)))
+                    self.assertTrue(set(captures).issubset(baseline))
+                    self.assertTrue(set(compiled).issubset(captures))
+                    for raw in range(1, baseline[-1] + 1):
+                        original = baseline[bisect.bisect_left(baseline, raw)]
+                        padded = mod.BaseCudaGraphRunner._pad_to_bucket(raw, captures)
+                        self.assertGreaterEqual(padded, raw)
+                        self.assertLessEqual(padded, 2 * original)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

Thanks for splitting this out, keeping the default dense and measuring c10, c24 and c48. That addresses the scope and measurement requests from my review on #46622.

On AIME the paired results are small either way. Across problem and seed pairs, 2 are right only on main and 1 only on the PR (GSM8K 24 and 27), so they neither show a regression nor rule one out. Main solved `source_index` 21 in both c24 seeds, while the PR missed it twice (once at the length cap, once with a wrong answer), and the PR solved problem 29 in seed 42 where main did not. Since the quality requests run at temperature 0, extra seeds mainly vary the batching, so paired c24 repeats that log the verification bucket each request used would be more informative. A run at batch 1 could serve as a control, though both policies keep bucket 1, so it would not exercise the changed padding.

The evidence also shows `max_total_num_tokens` at 1764480 on main and 1791616 with the flag in both seeds, about 1.5 percent more KV capacity. That fits KV sizing after graph capture absorbing the freed graph memory, would explain the flat peak, and could go in the Costs table.

My main question is when someone should turn this on. Throughput is lower at all three concurrencies, while the gains are about 24 s of startup and about 1.5 percent more KV tokens. Which workloads are meant to benefit? One measurement where faster startup or the extra KV capacity matters would help maintainers judge whether the flag is worth carrying.
